verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only automatic Activity retries and non-retryable error settings. That is a related reliability feature, not a dedicated error-handling path or error workflow, and nothing in the pack documents failure notifications. Community reports say errors can end up buried in the event log and that error-level cleanup is hard, which reinforces that neither part of the story is evidenced.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails
